sections.title: General
rules: Touchdowns and touchdown passes are 6 points; two-point conversions are 2.
Individual player scores cannot be less than zero.
Special-teams touchdowns count for the individual player.

sections.title: Passing
rules: 200 yards earns 2 points, plus 1 for each additional 50 yards.
Interceptions and fumbles lost are -1; a turnover returned for a touchdown is -3 total.

sections.title: Rushing and receiving
rules: RB/WR: 75 yards in either category earns 2 points, plus 1 per additional 25 yards.
RB/WR alternate: 100 combined yards earns 2 points, plus 1 per additional 25 yards.
TE: 50 yards in either category earns 2 points, plus 1 per additional 25 yards.
TE alternate: 75 combined yards earns 2 points, plus 1 per additional 25 yards.
The combined bonus is an alternative; use whichever yardage method scores more.

sections.title: Kicker
rules: PAT 1; field goals 1–29 yards 1, 30–39 yards 2, 40–49 yards 3, 50+ yards 4.
Missed or blocked field goals are -2; missed or blocked PATs are -1.

sections.title: Defense
rules: Interceptions, fumble recoveries, safeties, blocked punts, and blocked field goals are 2; sacks and blocked PATs are 1; eligible defensive touchdowns are 4.
Punt- and kickoff-return touchdowns do not count for DF scoring.

sections.title: Head coach
rules: Using the ESPN spread: home favorite win 4, home underdog win 5, road favorite win 6, road underdog win 7; loss or tie 0.

sections.title: League format
rules: Rank Points = matchup wins + Top-6 points + 0.5 × matchup ties.
A tie crossing the weekly sixth-place cutoff splits the available Top-6 points evenly.
Four teams reach the playoffs; the other eight play a two-week Jamboree in Weeks 16–17.
